entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The heavier build beside *torturous* - identical extremity, carried in a more laboured word.

entries.definition: causing a sharply painful or stinging sensation; used especially of cold
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Sharp and stinging where *aching* is dull, and cold above all is what it is said of.

entries.definition: causing a sharply painful or stinging sensation; used especially of cold
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same sharp sting held as a condition rather than an act - a bitter cold surrounds you where a biting one goes at you.

entries.definition: painful from having the skin abraded
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Small and local - the soreness of skin rubbed raw, at the shallow end of everything else here.

entries.definition: painful from having the skin abraded
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunter than *chafed* for the same abraded skin, with the sore itself in view rather than the rubbing that made it.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The bare floor of the family - it says only that the thing is not ruled out, and promises nothing about anyone being able to bring it off.
examples: a breakthrough may be possible next year

entries.definition: capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and effortful, it frames the thing as a task with a finish line where *possible* frames nothing at all.

entries.definition: capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warmer than *accomplishable* - it treats the thing as a goal worth reaching and quietly credits whoever would reach it.

entries.definition: capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plainest and most informal of the set, it shrinks a thing down to size in a way *accomplishable* never manages.

entries.definition: capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Concedes that the thing will take effort and says it fits inside capacity anyway, a fainter endorsement than *achievable*.

entries.definition: capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal, and it looks past the doing to the outcome - the thing brought from prospect into fact.

entries.definition: capable of being affirmed or asserted
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Technical and colourless: it rates whether a claim can be stood behind, and passes no judgement on the claim itself.
examples: a quality affirmable of every member of the family

entries.definition: capable of being affirmed or asserted
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Blunter in its verb than *affirmable* - putting a claim forward rather than standing behind one - but it carries no more approval.

entries.definition: capable of being attained or accomplished
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Points at something wanted and says the reach is long enough, giving it a pull toward the goal that *possible* has none of.

entries.definition: capable of being attained or accomplished
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal and homely, it makes the thing sound simply within arm's length, deflating the reach that *attainable* dignifies.
examples: art is not something that is come-at-able by dint of study

entries.definition: possible but not certain to occur
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The one member that withholds - it grants the possibility and in the same breath refuses to promise it, hedging where *feasible* endorses.
examples: they had to plan for contingent expenses

entries.definition: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A working verdict rather than a hope: it says the thing can be done with what is at hand now, a test *possible* never applies.

entries.definition: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most procedural of the set, it asks only whether the steps can be carried out and offers no opinion on whether they should be.
